* This class defines the Extensions attribute for the Certificate.
 *
 * @author Amit Kapoor
 * @author Hemma Prafullchandra
 * @see CertAttrSet

variables.name: IDENT
variables.comment:
* Identifier for this attribute, to be used with the
     * get, set, delete methods of Certificate, x509 type.

methods.name: private void init(DerInputStream in) throws IOException
private void parseExtension(Extension ext) throws IOException
public void encode(OutputStream out) throws CertificateException, IOException
methods.comment:
* Encode the extensions in DER form to the stream, setting
     * the context specific tag as needed in the X.509 v3 certificate.
     *
     * @param out the DerOutputStream to marshal the contents to.
     * @exception CertificateException on encoding errors.
     * @exception IOException on errors.

methods.name: public void encode(OutputStream out, boolean isCertReq) throws CertificateException, IOException
methods.comment:
* Encode the extensions in DER form to the stream.
     *
     * @param out the DerOutputStream to marshal the contents to.
     * @param isCertReq if true then no context specific tag is added.
     * @exception CertificateException on encoding errors.
     * @exception IOException on errors.

methods.name: public void set(String name, Object obj) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Set the attribute value.
     * @param name the extension name used in the cache.
     * @param obj the object to set.
     * @exception IOException if the object could not be cached.

methods.name: public Extension get(String name) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Get the attribute value.
     * @param name the extension name used in the lookup.
     * @exception IOException if named extension is not found.

methods.name: public void delete(String name) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Delete the attribute value.
     * @param name the extension name used in the lookup.
     * @exception IOException if named extension is not found.

methods.name: public String getNameByOid(ObjectIdentifier oid) throws IOException
public Enumeration<Extension> getElements()
methods.comment:
* Return an enumeration of names of attributes existing within this
     * attribute.

methods.name: public Collection<Extension> getAllExtensions()
methods.comment:
* Return a collection view of the extensions.
     * @return a collection view of the extensions in this Certificate.

methods.name: public String getName()
methods.comment: * Return the name of this attribute.

methods.name: public boolean hasUnsupportedCriticalExtension()
methods.comment:
* Return true if a critical extension is found that is
     * not supported, otherwise return false.

methods.name: public boolean equals(Object other)
methods.comment: * Compares this CertificateExtensions for equality with the specified * object. If the other object is an * instanceof CertificateExtensions, then * all the entries are compared with the entries from this. * * @param other the object to test for equality with this * CertificateExtensions. * @return true iff all the entries match that of the Other, * false otherwise.

methods.name: public int hashCode()
methods.comment:
* Returns a hashcode value for this CertificateExtensions.
     *
     * @return the hashcode value.

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment:
* Returns a string representation of this CertificateExtensions * object in the form of a set of entries, enclosed in braces and separated * by the ASCII characters ", " (comma and space). *

Overrides to toString method of Object. * * @return a string representation of this CertificateExtensions.
